comparison_method: Exact text hash of function declaration through top-level closing brace; function bodies read only, not copied into deliverables or translated into code. Semantic rules independently authored as declarative prose.
limitations: Function source inspection does not prove server, driver, binding or provisioning behavior.
Native options/OS/transport/rounding and update baselines remain explicit context gaps.
The 66 acquisition records include repeated acquisitions of 62 distinct immutable upstream source identities; record identifiers are optional and are not source uniqueness claims.
